core_ideas.idea: Learn DSA smarter with personalized ChatGPT prompts instead of passive tutorials
core_ideas.why: Tutorials teach everyone the same way, but 7 tailored prompts adapt to your level, mistakes, and pace to build concept intuition, debug code, break down problems, spot patterns, and analyze complexity
core_ideas.trade_off: You still have to do real solving and verify answers — AI can hallucinate and won't build muscle memory without practice

core_ideas.idea: Use free mock-interview tools to practice under real conditions
core_ideas.why: Pramp for live peer mocks, Exponent for FAANG frameworks, Google Warmup for AI voice practice, and InterviewBit for structured coding paths simulate interview pressure without paid courses
core_ideas.trade_off: Peer match quality varies, free tiers limit sessions, and you need consistency to see improvement

core_ideas.idea: Storytelling in 9 minutes makes your interview answers memorable
core_ideas.why: Beyond correct code, recruiters remember engaging stories about your projects and decisions — crucial for behavioral rounds and explaining trade-offs
core_ideas.trade_off: Quick tips only work if you practice out loud; over-rehearsed stories can sound robotic

core_ideas.idea: Master system design by practicing 25 canonical HLD questions by domain
core_ideas.why: Rate limiter, URL shortener, Twitter/Instagram feeds, WhatsApp/Discord/Zoom, YouTube/Netflix/Spotify, and storage/booking designs for SDE-2/SDE-3 reuse the same patterns, with Excalidraw workspaces for hands-on drawing
core_ideas.trade_off: Each design takes hours and assumes you already know distributed systems basics — it's a long grind, not a quick hack

core_ideas.idea: Great prep loops DSA + system design + storytelling + mock tools together
core_ideas.why: DSA and system design test hard skills while storytelling and mock interviews test communication — together they mirror the full hiring funnel from coding screen to HLD to behavioral
core_ideas.trade_off: Juggling all four at once is overwhelming; without a weekly schedule you risk shallow prep in each area

disagreements.point: Best learning mode: quit tutorials and learn solo with personalized ChatGPT vs. use structured video lessons and peer mocks via Exponent/Pramp
